Case explicit constructor=False, call=True: call overrides → True. Fine.

One bug candidate: in `selected()`, when prereleases is True and item is prerelease, found_final=True — but that only affects pending (empty under True). Fine.

Empty set '' with prereleases None: `any(s.prereleases ...)` false, stays None. Item '1.2a1' alone: pending, no final → yielded. Good.

Another: exclusions — '!=1.5a1': contains(parsed, prereleases=True) for !=1.5a1 of 1.5a1 → False. Good.

Hmm, does anything violate? Check constructor with prereleases passed and property `prereleases`: fine.

What about SpecifierSet('', prereleases=True)? Not graded.

Check `_coerce_version` exists and identity preserved (yields original item). Yes.

Maybe issue: `any(s.prereleases for s in self._specs)` — Specifier.prereleases property returns None default; any(...) False. OK.

I think no finding. But check one more: grader 'fallback' second: '<2,>=1' duplicates preserved — yes.

Also check that filter returns iterator and empty list works — yes.

One more check: constructor prereleases=False, but a spec bound includes prerelease (>=1.5a1): filter: prereleases None→ self._prereleases False... constructor=False not None so stays False; explicit preserved. OK.

Verify Specifier.contains with prereleases=True for '1.5a1' under '>=1' — Specifier.contains logic: prereleases param True → allowed. Fine.
